newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ASB Bank lifts NZ floating mortgage rate to 10.4pc.
newsitem.headline: ASB Bank lifts NZ floating mortgage rate to 10.4pc.

text.p: ASB Bank said on Thursday it had increased its floating lending rate to 10.4 percent from 8.9 percent, bringing it into line with other major bank lenders.
The bank's fixed rates remain unchanged, with the one-year rate at 8.95 percent, two-year rate at 9.15 percent and the three year rate at 9.25 percent.

"We held off increasing our floating rate until now so we could be certain that the prevailing money market rates had settled at a consistent level, and that the recent steep increases were not temporary," managing director Ralph Norris said in a statement.
The new floating rate will apply immediately for new borrowers, and for existing borrowers from September 8.
